# pve_vm_snapshot_rollback (Action)

Roll a VM back to a snapshot.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "pve_vm_snapshot_rollback" "example" {
  config {
  node = "pve1"
  snapname = "CHANGE_ME"
  vmid = 100
  }
}

# terraform_data is a no-op stand-in; wire action.pve actions to the
# lifecycle events of any managed resource.
resource "terraform_data" "trigger" {
  lifecycle {
    action_trigger {
      events  = [after_create]
      actions = [action.pve_vm_snapshot_rollback.example]
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node name.
- `snapname` (String) The name of the snapshot.
- `vmid` (Number) The (unique) ID of the VM.

### Optional

- `start` (Boolean) Whether the VM should get started after rolling back successfully. (Note: VMs will be automatically started if the snapshot includes RAM.) (default: 0)
